issue.title: Cannot downscale from 3 to 1 mdi nodes in v7.0.0
issue.body:
How to reproduce:
1. deploy a 7.0.0 3-nodes cluster:
```yaml
apiVersion: elasticsearch.k8s.elastic.co/v1alpha1
kind: Elasticsearch
metadata:
  name: sample
spec:
  version: 7.0.0
  nodes:
    - config:
        node.master: true
        node.data: true
        node.ingest: true
        xpack.license.self_generated.type: trial
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1Gi
          cpu: 1
      nodeCount: 3
```
2. wait for deployment to be complete
3. downscale to 1 node
```yaml
apiVersion: elasticsearch.k8s.elastic.co/v1alpha1
kind: Elasticsearch
metadata:
  name: sample
spec:
  version: 7.0.0
  nodes:
    - config:
        node.master: true
        node.data: true
        node.ingest: true
        xpack.license.self_generated.type: trial
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1Gi
          cpu: 1
      nodeCount: 1
```
4. the operator logs the following and never deletes any pod:
